name: Microsoft Dataverse MCP
description: Lets MCP clients such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot search, query, and update Dataverse tables and records, for Power Platform teams wiring agents to business data.

skills.name: Search Data And Schemas
skills.description: Searches structured and unstructured Dataverse data, and searches table schemas and business skills by keyword.

skills.name: Manage Records
skills.description: Creates, updates, and deletes table rows, deleting only after explicit user approval.

skills.name: Manage Tables
skills.description: Creates tables with a specified schema and modifies or deletes existing tables, with deletes gated on user approval.

skills.name: Run SQL Queries
skills.description: Runs supported Dataverse SQL SELECT queries against your environment's tables.

skills.name: Upload And Download Files
skills.description: Generates SAS URLs for file uploads and downloads, and commits completed uploads.
